research_notes.scope: Senior Living / Healthcare - HUD 232 / Agency (permanent & construction). Researched 2026-11-02.
research_notes.method_limits: Two passes on 2026-11-02. Lender websites were blocked by network policy (no WebFetch), so all values come from search-indexed excerpts of lender and trade-press pages. Phones, emails and contacts were recorded only where an excerpt quoted them verbatim. Both passes stopped when the shared WebSearch budget ran out (pass 2 used 45 searches). Lenders left in 'unverified_not_researched' were not excluded on the merits.
research_notes.hud_broker_fee_rule: HUD Section 232 rules bar a mortgagee from paying a referral fee to any person or organization. A broker fee can be paid only inside the lender's Financing/Placement fee limits, and the broker must have healthcare-finance experience and no identity-of-interest with the participants other than the lender. So outside brokers on HUD 232 deals are paid from the lender's fee (co-origination / fee split), not a separate referral fee.
research_notes.fy2025_hud_232_lean_ranking: McKnight's (FY2025, HUD LEAN/232): 1 Greystone (72 loans, $1.3B); 2 KeyBank (28, $809.7M); 3 VIUM Capital (44 loans, >$714.3M; #2 by count); 4 Dwight Capital (31, $475.3M); 5 NewPoint (24, $445.3M); 6 Berkadia (27, $316.7M). Senior Housing Business: CFG #7 (21 loans, $311.4M); Lument #9 (18 loans, $244.4M). multifamily.loans Section 232 table: Walker & Dunlop #9 ($250.9M, 22 loans) and First American Capital #10 ($219.6M, 7 loans). The sources disagree on #8-#10. Total Section 232 closings rose from 202 (FY2024) to 337 (FY2025).
research_notes.agency_seniors_lender_lists: Fannie Mae Seniors Housing Lenders page (undated) lists: Bellwether Enterprise Real Estate Capital, Berkadia Commercial Mortgage, Capital One N.A., CBRE Multifamily Capital, Grandbridge Real Estate Capital, Greystone Servicing Company, JLL Real Estate Capital, KeyBank N.A., Lument, M&T Realty Capital, Newmark, PGIM Real Estate, Regions Real Estate Capital Markets, Walker & Dunlop, Wells Fargo Multifamily Capital. Freddie Mac Optigo Seniors Housing (directory plus a seniors investor presentation that is about 4 years old): Arbor Agency Lending, Berkadia, BWE, Capital One, CBRE, Grandbridge, Greystone, JLL, KeyBank, Lument, M&T, Newmark, NewPoint, PGIM, Walker & Dunlop, Wells Fargo. Freddie Mac top Seniors Housing lender: Berkadia (2025), Wells Fargo (2024). Fannie Mae top Seniors Housing DUS producers 2024: Berkadia, JLL, Newmark, M&T Realty Capital, CBRE.
research_notes.h1_fy2026_hud_232_ranking: Through Mar 31, 2026 (H1 FY2026): VIUM #1 (41 closed loans, ~$600M; ~$900M incl. firm commitments, per VIUM); Greystone #2 (23, ~$455M); KeyBank (16, ~$344M); Dwight (17, ~$304M). HUD LEAN total: 190 loans, ~$3.2B (McKnight's).
